_note: Reflective questions PAI asks, in this order, to get to know the student (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 2.2). The prompt is English; the Writer asks it in the student's own words and language. intent_key is logged in the turn decision and never asked twice. An item is skipped while any of its vault_types already holds an entry, when the student's last message already covered its area, and under the area's decline cooldown and sensitivity rules (areas_policy.json). followup_prompt is asked once when the student answers an item with a short reply. about_you is the open first question: the opening or the intro asks it. bank_max_in_a_row: after that many bank questions in a row (the intro counts), a missing education basic (areas_policy education_basics) is asked before the bank continues.

items.prompt: Tell me about yourself: what you do these days and what matters to you.
items.followup_prompt: Tell me a bit more: what does a normal day look like for you?

items.prompt: What do you enjoy doing in your free time, especially anything a little unusual?
items.followup_prompt: What is it about that you enjoy most?

items.prompt: Is there something you have achieved, an award, a result or something you made, that really matters to you?
items.followup_prompt: What did it take to get there?

items.prompt: Which activities outside class are you proud of, and what was your role in them?
items.followup_prompt: What did you do there yourself?

items.prompt: What is a challenge you have faced that shaped how you think or work?
items.followup_prompt: How did you deal with it?

items.prompt: How has your background, your family, city or culture, opened doors for you or made things harder?
items.followup_prompt: Can you give me one example?

items.prompt: How would your friends describe you?
items.followup_prompt: Why do you think they would say that?

items.prompt: Is there a principle or a cause you really care about?
items.followup_prompt: Why does it matter to you?

items.prompt: Is there anything else important about you that I should know?
items.followup_prompt: Anything at all, big or small?
